jobs.detail: WALL SIT MARCH, THREE phases showing active march per canonical instructions despite isometric base category. SIDE FRONT three-quarter view, a plain WHITE vertical WALL BEHIND body as faint light-gray edge/contact shadow, not full room. Back/pelvis pressed to wall, hips low in wall-sit, thighs roughly horizontal, knees90degrees, feet forward so shins vertical. Hands on hips, torso upright, no seat/chair/bench. LEFT panel BOTH feet hip width flat on floor. MIDDLE lift RIGHT knee toward chest modestly, right foot CLEAR off floor, right knee stays bent, LEFT foot flat under left knee supports body; pelvis height/back wall contact unchanged. RIGHT panel LOWER right foot flat, lift LEFT knee/foot toward chest, left foot clear off floor, RIGHT foot planted. Same hip height, stable pelvis, no standing up or sliding down, no leg length changes, clear opposite leg identities. Primary GLUTES only ONE faint soft BLURRED RED color tint over intact BLACK side/rear hip shorts, no red quads/knees/calves/abs. Shorts full continuous opaque front/sides/back/seat/crotch even lifted knee; shirt opaque BLACK, limbs detailed grayscale. Whole person, all hands/shoes, enough wall/floor contact within EACH spacious panel.

jobs.detail: MEDICINE BALL SIT-UP TO WALL, THREE phases. SIDE THREE-QUARTER view, head/body IMAGE LEFT, feet toward plain light gray WHITE WALL on IMAGE RIGHT, same wall distance/model/camera through phases. Floor seated position knees bent, both feet flat hip-width, soles not braced against wall, wall about1metre beyond toes. ONE round dark GRAYSCALE textured MEDICINE BALL held/released/caught in each phase, no other balls/weights. LEFT lie back with HEAD/back on floor, knees bent feet planted, BOTH hands hold ball at chest. MIDDLE perform sit-up to upright seated torso, knees/feet unchanged, BOTH arms extend FORWARD in chest-pass release, palms forward/fingers open; ball is FREE in air near WALL at chest height about to contact wall, not hovering over head. RIGHT seated upright remains, elbows flex and BOTH hands CATCH SAME returning ball in front of CHEST, five-finger contact round ball, no extra ball. Ball size identical across phases, no arrows or trails. After catch lower back controlled (not shown extra). Primary ABS only ONE soft DIFFUSE BLURRED RED tint printed over intact OPAQUE BLACK abdominal shirt, no six-pack lines, muscle divisions, fibers or clothing cutaways. Entire torso/seat/crotch/front/sides/back continuously opaque black clothes, limbs exposed detailed grayscale. Whole person/shoes/hands/ball AND relevant wall surface fit within each panel with white margins.
